name: electrolytic-smd-vent

provenance: Original work, authored through SolidCraft's commands by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored` (`author_parts/families.rs`); saved at Panasonic's size code D from the public FK series datasheet (06-Dec-19, p. 1; https://static.chipdip.ru/lib/426/DOC042426188.pdf downloaded 18 November 2026); the vent score's size estimated.
